svg.text: Detailed LMS Data Flow - Actual Controllers, Services, Workers, Decisions, Reporting
Legend: solid arrows = request/state progression | dotted verticals = API-to-backend handoff | diamonds = business/control decisions | blue = platform/UI | teal
= backend | amber = correction | red = exception | green = success
Grounded in repo: generated API schema, controller mappings, services/workers, Flyway RLS/audit/idempotency tables, R2/MinIO storage, scheduled claim/retry workers.
